profile:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(allow process-exec)
(allow process-fork)
(allow sysctl-read)
(allow mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.bsd.dirhelper") (global-name "com.apple.system.opendirectoryd.libinfo"))
(allow system-sched (target self))
(allow sysctl-write (sysctl-name "vfs.nspace.prevent_materialization"))
(allow signal (target same-sandbox))
(allow file-read*)
(allow file-write-data (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/dtracehelper"))
(allow file-write-data file-ioctl (literal "/dev/tty"))
(allow file-write-data file-ioctl (regex #"^/dev/fd/[0-9]+$"))
(allow file-write* (subpath (param "WRITABLE_ROOT_0")))
(allow file-write* (subpath (param "WRITABLE_ROOT_1")))
(deny file-write* (subpath (param "WRITE_DENIED_0")))
(deny file-write* (subpath (param "WRITE_DENIED_1")))
(deny file-write* (subpath (param "WRITE_DENIED_2")))
(deny file-write* (subpath (param "WRITE_DENIED_3")))
(deny file-write* (subpath (param "WRITE_DENIED_4")))
(allow file-write* (subpath (param "SESSION_TMP_0")))
(deny file-write-unlink (literal (param "GUARDED_ANCESTOR_0")))
(deny file-write-unlink (literal (param "GUARDED_ANCESTOR_1")))
(deny file-read* (subpath (param "READ_DENIED_0")))
(deny file-read* (subpath (param "READ_DENIED_1")))
(deny file-read* (subpath (param "READ_DENIED_2")))
(deny file-read* (subpath (param "READ_DENIED_3")))
(allow file-read* (subpath (param "READ_ALLOWED_0")))
(allow file-read-metadata (literal (param "READ_METADATA_0")))
(allow network-outbound (remote ip))
(allow network-outbound (remote unix-socket (path-literal "/private/var/run/mDNSResponder")))
(deny network-outbound (remote unix-socket (subpath (param "READ_DENIED_0"))))
(deny network-outbound (remote unix-socket (subpath (param "READ_DENIED_1"))))
(deny network-outbound (remote unix-socket (subpath (param "READ_DENIED_2"))))
(deny network-outbound (remote unix-socket (subpath (param "READ_DENIED_3"))))
